skills.summary: Stage, group by category, draft a clean commit, push
skills.description: Stages all changes, groups files by category, drafts a linepush-style conventional commit message, commits, and pushes. Built for a clean, reviewable history without hand-writing commit bodies every time.
skills.whenToUse: Use when you want to commit and push the current working tree, or need an AI-drafted conventional commit from staged/unstaged changes.
highlights: Inspects status, diffs, and recent history before writing the message
Stages everything, then categorizes the changeset
Drafts a linepush-style conventional commit
Commits and pushes to the tracked remote branch

skills.summary: Generate README with stack, deps, prerequisites, setup
skills.description: Generates or rewrites a project README from the real codebase — title, description, tech stack, dependencies, prerequisites, installation, and setup. Prefers accuracy over marketing filler and does not invent APIs or env vars that are not in the repo.
skills.whenToUse: Use when you need a project README, setup docs, or a rewrite of README.md grounded in actual config and scripts.
highlights: Infers stack from package manifests and framework configs
Collects scripts, engines, and .env.example names (never secrets)
Preserves intentional extras like badges when rewriting
Sanity-checks commands before finishing

skills.summary: Run react-doctor, fix findings, verify no regressions
skills.description: Runs React Doctor, constructs fixes for all findings, and verifies that implementations and features still work. Prefers root-cause fixes over mass-suppressions, and re-checks after each batch of edits.
skills.whenToUse: Use on React / Next / Vite / Remix / Expo apps when you want a full react-doctor clean-up without regressions.
highlights: Confirms the project is a React-family app
Baseline verbose + JSON scan
Fixes findings in prioritized batches
Re-scans and runs project verification until clean

skills.summary: Run Larastan on Laravel, fix, verify
skills.description: Runs Larastan (PHPStan for Laravel), fixes all findings, and verifies features still work. Does not mass-ignore or regenerate baselines to “pass” — prefers root-cause static analysis fixes.
skills.whenToUse: Use on Laravel apps when you want Larastan/PHPStan errors cleaned up without breaking behavior.
highlights: Confirms Laravel + Larastan availability
Baseline analyse then triage by priority
Fix in explain → edit → verify batches
Re-analyse until clean and report leftovers if any

skills.summary: Knip on NestJS — unused code/deps out, features intact
skills.description: Runs Knip on NestJS projects, fixes unused files, exports, and dependencies, then verifies features still work. Nest-aware config and no mass-ignore shortcuts.
skills.whenToUse: Use on NestJS apps to clean unused code and dependencies without breaking modules or features.
highlights: Confirms NestJS project shape
Ensures Nest-aware Knip config
Baseline scan and prioritized triage
Re-scan until clean with verification between batches

skills.summary: Bundled node-doctor (Knip + hygiene) for generic Node
skills.description: Runs the bundled node-doctor tool (Knip + package hygiene) on generic Node.js libraries, CLIs, or services. Fixes unused exports/deps and checks bin/main/exports/scripts/engines — then verifies nothing broke.
skills.whenToUse: Use for generic Node packages. Prefer nestjs-knip-fix for Nest and react-doctor-fix for React-first apps.
highlights: Routes Nest/React apps to the right specialist skill
Knip via bundled node-doctor config when needed
Package hygiene checks for entrypoints and engines
Batch fixes with re-scan and final verification

rules.summary: Choosing React SPA vs Laravel API vs Next/Nuxt marketing
rules.description: Guidance for when to use React SPA dashboards, Laravel API-only backends, and Next.js or Nuxt marketing sites. Keeps product surfaces in the right stack instead of mixing concerns.
rules.whenToUse: Use when choosing or mixing frontends and backends, or deciding which specialized rule to apply.
highlights: Dashboard/admin → React client SPA
Backend API → Laravel API-only
Marketing/content → Next.js or Nuxt
Clear boundaries between SEO sites and authenticated SPAs

rules.description: Rules for client-side SPA dashboards (Vite + React + TypeScript) that talk to a Laravel API. No App Router, SSR, or RSC — feature folders, typed clients, and composition-first components.
rules.whenToUse: Use for authenticated dashboard/admin SPAs consuming a separate Laravel API.
highlights: Browser SPA only — no Next App Router here
Feature-oriented folder structure
Strict TypeScript and focused components
Typed API client toward Laravel JSON endpoints

rules.description: Laravel API-only backend rules for headless SPA clients. Prefer JSON APIs, Form Requests, API Resources, and Sanctum — not Blade/Livewire/Inertia unless explicitly requested.
rules.whenToUse: Use when Laravel is the API backend for a React SPA or other JSON clients.
highlights: REST/JSON first; thin controllers
Form Requests + API Resources
Sanctum for SPA or token auth
Consistent error JSON shapes

rules.summary: Next.js App Router marketing / branding sites
rules.description: Next.js App Router rules for marketing and branding websites. Optimize for SEO, performance, and content-driven pages — not authenticated SPA dashboards.
rules.whenToUse: Use for landings, brand sites, blogs, and campaigns on Next.js.
highlights: Server Components by default
metadata / generateMetadata per page
Semantic HTML and strong SEO defaults
Keep client bundles lean on marketing pages

rules.description: Nuxt 3+ rules for marketing and branding websites. Composition API, file-based routing, SEO utilities, and content-first rendering — not authenticated SPA dashboards unless explicitly chosen.
rules.whenToUse: Use for Nuxt marketing, landings, and content-heavy brand sites.
highlights: Vue 3 Composition API with script setup
useSeoMeta / useHead on public pages
SSG/SSR-friendly data fetching
Runtime config for env — never hardcode secrets
